description: YouTube discovery and engagement via the Data API v3 (search/read/list on an API key; youtube_comment writes as the authorised user over OAuth2 -- #227).

youtube_search.description: Search videos matching a query (search.list, type=video). Costs 100 quota units per call, the most expensive endpoint in this API.

youtube_list.description: List a channel's uploads (playlistItems.list on its uploads playlist). CHANNEL accepts a channel ID, an @handle, a bare name tried as a handle, or a youtube.com/channel/... or youtube.com/@... URL.

youtube_read.description: Read video title + channel + stats + top N inline comments (with comment IDs). Accepts a bare video ID or a watch/youtu.be/shorts/embed URL. A video with comments disabled degrades to a note rather than failing.

youtube_auth.description: One-time OAuth2 browser flow for the write ops: opens a loopback consent page and caches a refresh token at ~/.config/youtube/oauth_token.json (0600). `youtube_auth:status` reports what is cached without touching the network, in three states -- AUTHORISED, NOT AUTHORISED, and CANNOT TELL for a cache that will not parse.

youtube_comment.description: Post ONE top-level comment (commentThreads.insert, 50 quota units), then read it back and report verified / MISMATCH / could-not-verify separately -- a 2xx is not visibility, because YouTube holds or shadow-bans programmatic comments silently. Refuses without |force: a second comment on a video already in ~/.config/youtube/sent.jsonl, more than 5 writes in an hour, or a sentinel log it cannot read. Appends the [AI-generated] marker unless no_publish_disclosure is set.
